text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"N.A."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- (English) 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field states \"N.A.\" while note N3 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a case depth of 0.8–1.2 mm, creating a contradiction that could cause the part to be manufactured without the required hardness. The designer must update the title block heat treatment field to reflect the requirements in note N3 and specify at which manufacturing stage the treatment applies.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment field from \"N.A.\" to match the case hardening specification in note N3, and clarify the process stage (e.g., after rough machining, before final grinding)."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D3","page":1,"quote":"⌀25 H7"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: 20MnCr5 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.30 kg"}],"comment":"Dimension D3 specifies a ⌀25 H7 fit on a part that receives an I.Z.B.P. (trivalent zinc) plating per note N5, but no allowance is made for the plating thickness on this tight-tolerance feature. Without accounting for the coating buildup, the plated bore will be undersize and the intended H7 fit will not assemble. The designer must either add a plating-thickness allowance to the pre-plate dimension or add a note requiring reaming/machining after plating.","recommended_correction":"Specify the pre-plating tolerance for the ⌀25 H7 bore to allow for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness, or add a note instructing the supplier to machine the bore to final size after plating."}]}
